detailed_description:
The video is styled as modern social-first product photography with a tactile, editorial energy. The lighting is natural and even, utilizing a color palette of crisp whites, cream (#F0E6D3), coral (#D4536D), deep charcoal (#1A1A1A), and a soft mint green. Skin tones are warm and natural with lifted shadows to keep the atmosphere airy. 

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the scene begins with <Subject 1> in a neighborhood diner during the afternoon. <Subject 3> enters the frame at the booth edge, presenting a paper check. <Subject 2> reaches out to take the check; as her hand moves, she leaves a faint coral-colored print on a white paper cup sitting nearby. The camera performs a light, quick pan to follow the movement. <Subject 2> says <d>[English] You’re giving me this?</d>.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up detail shot. <Subject 5> takes the <Subject 4> lipstick, snaps a quick photo of it with a phone, and then caps the lipstick with a satisfying tactile click. She tucks the lipstick into the pocket of <Subject 2>’s olive jacket. The exchange is portrayed as easy and affectionate. <Subject 5> says <d>[English] You need it more.</d>. The camera uses a quick tactile tilt to emphasize the material finish of the lipstick.

overall_soundscape:
The sound of a paper check slipping onto a table followed by the muffled ambience of a busy diner and soft rain hitting the window. A sharp camera shutter click followed by the distinct mechanical click of a lipstick cap closing.
